## Checks

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run build`, `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets`, `cargo fmt`
- [ ] A change of behavior has a test
- [ ] New interface text is in `src/i18n/locales/*.json` (same keys in every language)
- [ ] A new dependency is in `docs/DEPENDENCIES.md` with a GPL-3.0-compatible license
- [ ] No keys or dictated text in logs
